title: The King of Fighters '97
note: Name of the character currently fighting next to P1, P2 or CPU (team read from RAM, FBNeo cheat codes).

retroarch.note: FinalBurn Neo core: Neo Geo 68000 RAM seen from 0x100000, bytes swapped within 16-bit words

credits.note: MVS credits (backup RAM), readable in MAME only

p1_mode.note: BIOS: player 1, 0 never played, 1 playing, 2 continue, 3 game over

bios_request.note: BIOS_USER_REQUEST: 2 demo, 3 title screen (asked by the BIOS when a coin goes in on an MVS)

bios_timer.note: BIOS_COMPULSION_TIMER: seconds left on the title screen before the game starts by itself

bios_mvs.note: BIOS_MVS_FLAG: 0 home console (AES, no coins), otherwise arcade (MVS)

health.note: health bar in %, full = 103 (cheat database); a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty; 0 is a fighter still standing, at his lowest (RetroAchievements code notes, The King of Fighters '98 0x8438: 0x0000 = lowest possible health while alive, underflows when dead), read as 1 since 1.31.1, it read as a K.O. in the middle of a fight (Seb)

health_p2.note: health bar in %, full = 103 (cheat database); a K.O. takes its 16-bit word below zero, its high byte at 0xFF (RetroAchievements code notes, lose = ff), which read as a full bar and hid every K.O. (Seb, 1.31): from 0x80 it reads empty; 0 is a fighter still standing, at his lowest (RetroAchievements code notes, The King of Fighters '98 0x8438: 0x0000 = lowest possible health while alive, underflows when dead), read as 1 since 1.31.1, it read as a K.O. in the middle of a fight (Seb)

_time_sub.note: the timer's fraction of a second (RetroAchievements code notes, 0xa83a Round - Time Remaining (frames / 50Hz)), it moves at every frame once the round's timer runs, FIGHT ! waits for it to come with the game's own FIGHT or GO (1.31.1)

_fight_state.note: the state of the fight (RetroAchievements code notes, 0xa787 Fight - State: 0x01 starting next round, 0x18 Ready, 0x19 round over, 0x1a fighting); READY at 0x18, FIGHT ! with GO 1.15 s later (1.31.1)

score.note: player 1 score, same place as in KOF 98 (identical player record), to be confirmed in game

score_p2.note: player 2 score, same place as in KOF 98 (identical player record), to be confirmed in game

beat.note: VS match, player 1 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat=...)

beat_p2.note: VS match, player 2 win streak (BEAT BY at the top of the screen), to find with learn.bat (beat2=...)

round.note: round of the match, from 0, one more at each K.O. (cheat database "Select Current Round", 1 to 6, as in The King of Fighters '98 where Seb saw it move at each K.O. in 1.31), shown as ROUND n when the next fight begins

backdrop.note: backdrop of the fight (cheat database "Select Backdrop"): 0 Koshien Stadium, Japan, 1 Adventureland, USA, 2 Tuban, Bali, 3 Kowloon, China, 4 Kyong Bock Kung, Korea, 5 Ruccass Corner, Monaco, 6 Orochi Team, 7 Orochi. Picks the HD theme in "hd": "stages"

_pow.note: P1 power gauge (RetroAchievements code notes, P1 POW Bar): in Advanced it fills to 0x80 and starts again at a stock, the green square of the game (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:15 (memory recording and 122 screenshots): 0x7C then 0x06 and a stock at 62.3 s, the square on his screenshot); in Extra the gauge full is 0x80 too (pow_full in hd), the bar of the panel under the name (1.33 test 49)

_pow_p2.note: P2 power gauge, the P1 one + 0x200 (in his game the CPU's gauge filled to three stocks; the second player's Extra gauge charged with A+B+C held, 0x07 to 0x80 in two seconds)

_stock.note: P1 stocks in Advanced (RetroAchievements code notes, POW Level; MAME cheat Infinite Power), 0 to 3: 1 at each full gauge, 0 again at each desperation move (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:15 (memory recording and 122 screenshots): 68.0 s, 103.1 s, 143.8 s, 182.1 s, 218.6 s)

_stock_p2.note: P2 stocks, the P1 one + 0x200 (the CPU reached 3 in his game)

_maxv.note: P1 MAX timer (RetroAchievements code notes, POW remaining), as in The King of Fighters '98: it counts down while MAX lasts

_maxv_p2.note: P2 MAX timer, the P1 one + 0x200: in his game the second player's MAX of Extra set it (0x37 at 287.6 s, 0x35 at 288.2 s), back to 0 at the desperation move

_pmode.note: P1 mode chosen before the match, 0 Advanced, 1 Extra (RetroAchievements code notes; MAME cheat Select Mode): 0 in his game, the bar with three squares of Advanced on his screenshots

_pmode_p2.note: P2 mode, the P1 one + 0x11 as the teams: 0 for the CPU, 1 when the second player came in and chose Extra (249.2 s)

_dm.note: P1 state flags (RetroAchievements code notes, Desperation Move bit 0): bit 0 set while a desperation move runs (Seb's game on the cabinet of 9 November 2026 13:15 (memory recording and 122 screenshots): from 68.0 s, 103.1 s, 143.8 s, 182.1 s, 218.6 s, each time the stock went), the panel says DM ! from it when the gauge of Extra empties over a second rather than at once

_dm_p2.note: P2 state flags, the P1 one + 0x200: bit 0 from 288.5 s, the second player's desperation move in MAX of Extra

_in_p1.note: BIOS_P1CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 1 (bit 0 up, 1 down, 2 left, 3 right, 4 A, 5 B, 6 C, 7 D, 1 = pressed), read at every frame ("fast") as in The King of Fighters '98 and 2002, so that a game recorded on the cabinet keeps every attempt at a desperation move, for this game's moves to come (1.33 test 48, the BIOS's own place in every Neo Geo game); nothing shown from it until the game file has its "moves"

_in_p2.note: BIOS_P2CURRENT: the stick and buttons of player 2, same bits (1.33 test 48)

moves.note: desperation moves of each fighter (DM), shown under the name when the gauge allows one (1.33 test 49): numpad notation for a fighter facing right, P any punch, K any kick, a letter for one button; from the MAME command.dat (Progetto-SNAPS, kof97 entry). 26 fighters have the same commands as in The King of Fighters '98 (whose list was checked against the Korean Enha wiki) and keep its names; Terry's Power Geyser and Kim's Houou Kyaku are 2141236 here, 21416 in '98, Athena's Crystal Bit 463214 and her Phoenix Arrow a punch; Kensou's Nikuman and the Orochi bosses left out

buttons.note: names of the buttons on the HD screen, as in The King of Fighters '98

hd.note: HD screen theme for each backdrop value (index = value), see the wiki, HD Marquee page; pow_full: the power gauge full at 0x80 (Seb's game of 9 November 2026: Advanced starts again at 0x7C to 0x80 with a stock, the MAX of Extra at 0x80), 0xA0 in '98 (1.33 test 49); stock_max: three stock squares whoever is lost, as on his screenshots (Robert with one teammate beaten: three squares, the CPU at three stocks: three green squares, no MAX written)
